summary: The observer previously assumed one squash parent and rejected a native merge used to preserve immutable cited revisions. The repaired source admits either existing one-parent squash semantics or exactly two ordered native PR base/head parents. Two-parent commits always reproduce the source tree using the existing bounded, complete-frontier unique-base clean three-way merge proof, even when head/source trees match; fetched parent order is independently verified. Reversed, unrelated, extra or malformed parents and extra source contents refuse. Native PR/source/repository association and stable final readbacks remain required. Original predecessor38564648933/a1 remains failed; local source tests do not establish hosted settlement, installed adoption or authority to retry a credential effect.
title: Ordinary settlement must authenticate merge shape and prove source composition
